purpose: Sentence-ready examples showing the required relationship between calculated facts, source-backed meaning, and the TLDR voice. These are calibration records, not hardcoded astrology facts.

slots.recognizableMoment: A family conversation, household plan, or message with a long history may need another pass.
slots.practicalResponse: Check what was actually said, confirm the practical details, and decide what needs to be put in writing now.

slots.planetInSignStory: Your sense of direction strengthens when you can think independently and contribute something useful to a larger group.
slots.recognizableExample: You may be the person who questions a rule everyone else blindly follows.

slots.headlineClause: A relationship, expense, or commitment may require a more honest limit.
slots.recognizableTransitExample: You may notice where keeping the peace has become more costly than naming what is sustainable.
slots.practicalResponseClause: Make one agreement clearer before adding another obligation.

slots.recognizableMoment: An emotional response may point toward a choice that supports where you are trying to grow.
slots.practicalResponse: Notice what feels easier to approach today, then take one concrete step while the opening is available.
